product_overview: Lovable Clone is a browser-based AI-powered code editor and app generator that enables users to create, edit, and preview complete web applications using natural language prompts through Google Gemini AI. It combines advanced AI-driven code generation with a professional development environment featuring a VS Code-like Monaco editor, live preview, multi-file management, and seamless IndexedDB persistence with responsive and accessible design optimized for mobile and desktop.
core_goals: Enable users to generate full HTML, CSS, and JavaScript applications from natural language descriptions using Google Gemini AI.
Provide a professional web-based IDE experience with capabilities like multi-file editing, syntax highlighting, and project file system management.
Deliver real-time sandboxed live preview updates reflecting code changes immediately for rapid iteration.
Ensure persistent project and file storage on the client using IndexedDB with robust migration and data integrity support.
Support mobile-first responsive design and advanced touch interactions including gestures, haptics, and voice commands in multiple languages.
Empower users to refine projects through an AI chat interface capable of conversational modifications, bug fixes, and feature additions.
Offer customizable AI model and API key settings alongside theme options with light, dark, and system modes.
Implement real-time sync with auto-save and conflict resolution to protect user work reliably.
Maintain high-quality code and experience with comprehensive testing (unit, integration, E2E) and strong security precautions like CSP and iframe sandboxing.
key_features: AI Code Generation: Generate full apps from natural language prompts using Google Gemini AI with streaming responses and retry logic.
Monaco Editor Integration: A powerful VS Code-like editor with syntax highlighting, multi-file support, and file operations (create, rename, delete).
Live Preview: Immediate sandboxed iframe preview of the running app reflecting live code changes.
IndexedDB Storage: Full-featured client-side persistent virtual file system with migration support ensuring file and project data integrity.
Project Management: Organize projects with categories, starring, filtering, and advanced search capabilities.
Settings Modal: Configure AI models, API keys, and preferences including multiple Gemini models (free and paid).
Theme System: Support for light, dark, and system themes with automatic detection and smooth transitions.
Toast Notifications: User feedback system with visually distinct notification types for success, errors, and info.
AI Chat Interface: Conversational AI integrated with context awareness for iterative development, modifications, bug fixes, and code suggestions.
Mobile First Design: Responsive UI optimized for mobile devices with touch-first and accessibility considerations.
Advanced Touch Interactions: Gestures, haptic feedback, swipe-to-delete, and long-press actions to enhance mobile usability.
Voice Commands: Multi-language voice input supporting Arabic and English with smart recognition.
Progressive Enhancement: Device capability detection with automatic UI adaptation across four enhancement levels.
Code Formatting: Built-in language-specific code formatting to maintain readable and consistent code.
Real-time Sync: Auto-save with debounced writes and conflict resolution to ensure current data and prevent loss.
Comprehensive Testing Suite: Extensive test coverage using Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright for unit, integration, and E2E tests.
Security First: Content Security Policies, secure headers, and sandboxed iframes to protect user projects and code execution environment.
Cross-Platform Support: Reliable experience on desktop, tablet, and mobile with device-specific optimizations.
user_flow_summary: User visits the app and sets up the Gemini AI API key and selects the AI model in the settings modal.
User enters a natural language prompt describing the desired web application in the input section and submits it.
The system sends the prompt to Google Gemini AI, which generates a project plan followed by streaming code generation of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files.
Generated files are saved into the IndexedDB-backed virtual file system and automatically loaded into the Monaco editor file explorer.
User edits code using the Monaco editor with real-time syntax highlighting and file management capabilities.
Live preview iframe updates instantly to reflect code changes in a secure sandbox environment.
User can invoke the AI chat interface to refine the project via conversational commands, bug fixes, or feature requests.
The system auto-saves all changes, syncs data, and resolves conflicts transparently.
User switches between theme modes (light, dark, system) triggering smooth UI transitions.
Mobile users benefit from touch gestures, haptic feedback, swipe actions, and voice command inputs.
Projects can be organized, searched, filtered, and starred on the project dashboard for efficient management.
User tests the app locally and exports or deploys the ready application.
validation_criteria: AI code generation produces syntactically valid and functional HTML/CSS/JS applications based on user prompts.
Monaco editor correctly supports multi-file editing, file operations (create, rename, delete), and syntax highlighting.
Live preview updates immediately and accurately reflect all code changes within a sandboxed iframe.
Projects and files persist across browser sessions with no data loss, including successful migrations of stored data.
Settings modal correctly saves and applies API keys and selected Gemini AI models.
Theme switching occurs smoothly with UI elements fully adapting to the selected theme mode.
Toast notifications appear correctly for successful operations, errors, and warnings.
AI chat interface processes natural language commands to refine code, fix bugs, and add features successfully.
Mobile touch interactions (gestures, haptics, swipe, long-press) function reliably on supported devices.
Voice command input correctly recognizes commands in English and Arabic and triggers expected actions.
Auto-save and real-time synchronization do not cause data conflicts or corruption under concurrent edits.
Code formatting utilities consistently enforce language-specific style rules on saved code.
Testing coverage meets or exceeds 70% across unit, integration, and E2E tests with no failing test cases.
Security policies effectively prevent injection attacks and unauthorized script execution.
Application performs smoothly and responsively on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices with no critical UI bugs.
